goals.title: Ship the October monthly release
goals.detail: Deployment package identified; deployed to Stage Nov 2 and Production Nov 4.

goals.title: Static MVP of C3DC interop
goals.detail: Nothing shipped. The Human Relevance story is On Hold waiting on the backend Data Retriever (In Progress); the C3DC prototype is in review and investigator review is In Progress.

goals.title: Close the interop security findings
goals.detail: Interop GraphQL introspection fix (Medium) closed Oct 30. The Node.js introspection variable and both Invicti rescans are in review.

goals.title: Clear the aged review queue
goals.detail: Synthetic data error handling (waiting since July), the Shiny migration and DMN example-file sync closed Oct 23. News page and Publications design are in review for a third sprint.

goals.title: Prefect cleanup and JBrowse
goals.detail: Jenkins servers terminated and the reference genome spike closed. Stage Prefect OpenSearch flows still time out; the JBrowse BAM fix is in review.

points.title: Tasks: 8 of 28 closed, 13 pts
points.detail: The October release (deployment package, Stage and Production), Jenkins teardown, the interop GraphQL fix, the reference genome spike, and both synthetic data tasks.

points.title: User stories: 1 of 2 closed
points.detail: DMN example files now stay in sync with the model (5 pts). The Human Relevance story (8 pts) is On Hold waiting on the backend.

points.title: Bugs: 2 of 5 closed
points.detail: The Studies page image collection tooltip and the News social media posts are fixed. JBrowse BAM tracks is in review; Explore page blank areas is On Hold; Stage Prefect timeouts reopened.

points.title: Epics: COTC021/022 v.3 carry
points.detail: Both submission epics stay open while study details are finalized. No new studies were released this sprint.

team.shoutout: Charles Ngu deployed the October release to Stage and Production and terminated the Jenkins servers. Ambar Rana closed the interop GraphQL fix on its date, cleared synthetic data error handling after four months in review, finished the reference genome spike and assembled the deployment package. Toyo Udosen got the DMN example files in sync with the model, and Valentina Epishina held the QA gate.
team.creditNote: Credit comes from the Jira Developer field (customfield_23650): the person who did the work. The Assignee is usually whoever moved the ticket to Closed, often QA, so it is not charted. A ticket with two developers counts for each; coordination work such as IndexD registration has no Developer by design.

awards.reason: Took the October release to Stage on Nov 2 and Production on Nov 4, then terminated the Jenkins servers.
Closed the interop GraphQL fix on Oct 30, cleared a ticket waiting since July, and finished the reference genome spike.
DMN example files now always match the data model, so users never download a stale example.

awards.name: Valentina Epishina
awards.reason: Verified and closed both release deployments, the interop GraphQL fix and the News social media fix.

risks.title: Stage Prefect OpenSearch flows time out
risks.detail: ICDC-4312 reopened Nov 12: Production flows now work, but Stage still hits the connection timeout. Stage indexing has to work before the next study load can be verified.
risks.nextStep: Charles gives a root cause and fix date today; Eric re-tests Stage once it lands.

risks.title: C3DC interop MVP slipped a sprint
risks.detail: It was a Sprint 53 goal. The Human Relevance story (8 pts) is On Hold waiting on the backend Data Retriever, and the prototype is still in review.
risks.nextStep: decide today: Eric gives a Data Retriever date, and the team confirms the MVP as a Sprint 54 goal.

risks.title: The review queue is still aging
risks.detail: 11 of 26 carry-overs are Ready for Review again. News page and Publications design are on their third sprint in review.
risks.nextStep: a named reviewer and review-by date for 4186, 4248 and 4242 before this meeting ends.

risks.title: Sprint 54 is 90% inherited
risks.detail: 26 of its 29 tickets carried from Sprint 53, leaving little room for new work.

retro.timingNote: Sprint 54 started November 12 and is already in motion. Action items from today either get folded into Sprint 54 now or deferred to Sprint 55 planning. Decide which as we assign each one.
retro.liked: The October release went out on schedule and long-waiting tickets finally closed. Say what made that work.
retro.lacked: The C3DC interop MVP did not ship and the same tickets sat in review again. Name the real cause.
retro.learned: Anything about sequencing frontend work behind backend work, moving work through review, or debugging environment-specific failures.
